text:
kevin: Reading the latest postmortem — recurring items keep resurfacing. Quick proposal: (A) require a one-line "follow-up card" on every postmortem with an explicit person, (B) run a short weekly 15m "fix triage" to clear blockers, and (C) add a lightweight recurrence tag so we can triage systemic issues.

izzy: +1. One-line cards are less friction. Also suggest adding a field for "next action" so it's always actionable.

martin: For rotation: keep the incident IC role for live ops, but assign a separate "follow-up lead" who owns remediations for 10 days after the incident. Rotate follow-up leads every 2 weeks.

tara: We need a comms cadence too: 1) initial 1h summary to #product, 2) brief 4h check-in if ongoing, 3) remediation board link in postmortem within 72h. That keeps stakeholders in the loop without spamming.

rosa: Recurrence buckets I use: capacity, routing, cache, release-regression, third_party, infra-config. If a tag appears 3x in 90d we flag for a cross-team fix.

kevin: Minimal follow-up card template (paste into remediation card):
```
owner: @handle
owner_contact: handle@redwood.ai
next_action: (one-line)
due: YYYY-MM-DD
recurrence_tag: capacity|routing|cache|release-regression|3p|infra-config
recurrence_count: 0
```

oncall-bot: NOTE: recurrence_count can be incremented automatically when incidents are linked to the remediation card via /incidents. See docs.

izzy: Escalation suggestion: if owner doesn't update card within 48h -> assign to secondary; 7 days -> escalate to team lead and add to next sprint. We should automate these where possible.

martin: Metrics to track during pilot: percent_remediations_closed_within_10d, avg_days_to_first_action, top-5 recurrence tags by count. Add them to weekly ops notes.

tara: Pilot plan: week 0 add card template to postmortem checklist; weeks 1-4 run weekly 15m triage and enforce 10-day follow-up ownership; week 5 retro.

rosa: I'll build a Grafana panel for recurrence tags and a small query to surface tags >=3 in 90d.

kevin: Action items:
- rosa -> Grafana recurrence panel + query -> due Thu
- izzy -> add follow-up card template to postmortem checklist PR -> due Tue
- martin -> schedule weekly 15m fix-triage and run first two sessions -> due Mon
- tara -> draft comm cadence snippets (1h, 4h, 72h) -> due Wed
Trial length: 5 weeks, measure the metrics martin listed.

oncall-bot: Scheduled: "fix-triage kickoff" in 2 days (participants: kevin, izzy, martin, tara, rosa).

izzy: I'll volunteer to help run the first triage.

kevin: Thanks all. I'll add a link to this thread in the current postmortem so folks can see the plan.

oncall-bot: Reminder: keep remediation card titles consistent: "incident-<id> - short-desc" for metric joins.
